speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by clarifying your symptoms. Have you experienced any sudden onset of vertigo, or is your dizziness more of a gradual sensation of lightheadedness? Additionally, have you noticed any hearing loss, ringing in your ears, or visual disturbances?

speaker: Patient
text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. He occasionally feels nauseous and has taken diphenhydramine to help him sleep, which also alleviates his symptoms slightly. He mentions recent increased intake of garlic due to trying to recover from a cold a few days ago. Past medical history is unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is helpful; the constant spinning suggests a vestibular issue rather than simple lightheadedness. Given your recent garlic intake and the possibility of an ototoxic reaction or a benign paroxysmal positional vertigo variant, have you noticed any changes in your hearing or tinnitus? Also, do you experience any worsening of symptoms when you roll over in bed or look up?

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Impressions (inner ear)
